---
title: "Component text-media"
video:
  width: 640
  height: 360
  fps: 30
---

Four text-media scenes, one per frame. The browser scene has its footage on
the right (the default) and shows the source from 1 s to 3 s. The others put
the footage on the left, or use the compatible animations, and show whole clips.

::: {.scene component="text-media" duration="2s"}
::: {.video src="assets/wide.mp4" placement="framed" frame="browser" fit="contain" sourceStart="1s" sourceEnd="3s" audio="mute" alt="A counter clip in a browser frame"}
:::

::: {.text}
Counter in a browser frame.
:::
:::

::: {.scene component="text-media" duration="2s" side="left" animation="fade-in"}
::: {.video src="assets/tall.mp4" placement="framed" frame="phone" fit="contain" audio="mute" alt="A counter clip in a phone frame"}
:::

::: {.text}
Phone frame on the left, with its text in the other column.
:::
:::

::: {.scene component="text-media" duration="3s" animation="reveal"}
::: {.video src="assets/four-three.mp4" placement="framed" frame="tablet" fit="cover" audio="mute" alt="A counter clip in a tablet frame"}
:::

::: {.text}
# Tablet frame
:::
:::

::: {.scene component="text-media" duration="3s" side="left" animation="slide-up"}
::: {.video src="assets/wide.mp4" placement="framed" frame="generic" fit="cover" audio="mute" alt="A counter clip in a generic frame"}
:::

::: {.text}
Text wraps in its own column, clear of the frame.
:::
:::
